native.parent_ownership: verified by gateway session resolution and compression-lineage checks before injection
native.profile_boundary: profile-local state.db and target session checks
native.arbitrary_session_injection: mitigated by target resolution, raw-session binding for API self-post, and adapter ownership
native.duplicate_delivery: durable claim/ack and bounded retry; not exactly-once
native.deleted_or_closed_parent: fail closed; terminal/ended non-compression targets are dropped
native.stale_child: owner recovery classifies abandoned running delegation as unknown
native.failure_timeout_cancel: terminal statuses are persisted and delivery can be retried/dropped
native.raw_output_leakage: native event fields are structured; AOTA outbox explicitly excludes raw logs/secrets/full reports

aota_boundary_requirements: at-least-once retry with observable terminal drop
no direct raw worker output injection
cross-profile route must be explicit rather than inferred
finding: The existing AOTA outbox satisfies sanitization and stable event identity at the producer boundary, but its current WebUI delivery boundary is not proven for official Desktop.
